name: GIIB Holdings Berhad
overview: GIIB Holdings Berhad 今年通过子公司 GIIB Project Management & Capital 签署两项谅解备忘录：一项是与 Farizon 和 CAF Motors 合作在马来西亚半岛开发 Farizon 商用车 4S 中心枢纽，另一项是拟有条件认购 Tricrest Foodie Trading 新股，此外，公司进行了股本拆细并多次发布附加上市公告，同时面临重大诉讼及审计师对持续经营能力的重大不确定性提出的保留意见。
overview_en: GIIB Holdings Berhad, through its subsidiary GIIB Project Management & Capital, signed two memoranda of understanding this year: one with Farizon and CAF Motors to develop a 4S centre hub for Farizon commercial vehicles in Peninsular Malaysia, and another for a proposed conditional share subscription into Tricrest Foodie Trading, which holds exclusive distribution and branding rights for Wonlucky products in Malaysia.

segments.name: 产业发展与建筑
segments.note: 今年通过子公司签署谅解备忘录，拟与 Farizon 和 CAF Motors 合作开发商用车 4S 中心枢纽。
segments.note_en: This year, through its subsidiary, signed a memorandum of understanding to collaborate with Farizon and CAF Motors to develop a commercial vehicle 4S centre hub.

actions.title: MEMORANDUM OF UNDERSTANDING
actions.text: 子公司 GIIB Project Management & Capital 与 Tricrest Foodie Trading 签署谅解备忘录，拟有条件认购其新股。
actions.text_en: Subsidiary GIIB Project Management & Capital entered into a memorandum of understanding with Tricrest Foodie Trading for a proposed conditional subscription of new shares;

model_changes.title: MEMORANDUM OF UNDERSTANDING
model_changes.text: 通过谅解备忘录拟进入商用车 4S 中心枢纽开发业务。
model_changes.text_en: Through a memorandum of understanding, proposed to enter the commercial vehicle 4S centre hub development business.

model_changes.title: MEMORANDUM OF UNDERSTANDING
model_changes.text: 通过谅解备忘录拟认购 Tricrest Foodie Trading 新股，间接涉足 Wonlucky 产品在马来西亚的独家分销业务。
model_changes.text_en: Through a memorandum of understanding, proposed to subscribe for new shares in Tricrest Foodie Trading, indirectly involving in the exclusive distribution business of Wonlucky products in Malaysia.
